description: Merged into assess-answer-turn.json when interviewos.interviewer.turn-state is on. Not a response schema on its own.

turnState.description: Whether the candidate had finished: complete, cut_off (stopped mid-thought) or needs_time (asked for time, or holding the floor with no answer yet).

candidateIntent.description: What kind of turn it was. Only meaningful when turnState is complete.

selfCorrection.description: When they corrected themselves: what they first said and what they meant, as 'first -> meant'.
